edges.reason: manualswap authorizes the caller by requiring _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes the caller by requiring _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address through transfer/transferFrom.
openTrading is protected by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender().
setBots is protected by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender().
delBot is protected by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender().
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping and used as a deadline, making timing miner-influenceable.
_transfer branches on cooldown[to] < block.timestamp to gate buys.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth, an external swap, while the caller execution context is still active.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which pushes native ETH to fee wallets mid-transfer.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap swap call that can re-enter the contract.
sendETHToFee performs native ETH transfers to externally controlled wallets.
openTrading calls createPair and addLiquidityETH, external calls on the router/factory.
openTrading assigns the router instance into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the pair created by the factory into uniswapV2Pair.
manualswap delegates to swapTokensForEth which makes an external Uniswap call.
manualsend delegates to sendETHToFee which transfers ETH externally.
manualswap requires the caller to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
onlyOwner checks _owner == _msgSender() before executing openTrading.
onlyOwner checks _owner == _msgSender() before executing setBots.
onlyOwner checks _owner == _msgSender() before executing delBot.
_transfer passes from/to/amount into the private _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard path.
_transferStandard obtains r/t value tuples from _getValues.
_transferStandard forwards the team token amount into _takeTeam.
_transferStandard forwards the reflection fee into _reflectFee.
_transferStandard mutates _rOwned balances using subtracted/added SafeMath values.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts the fee from _rTotal and grows _tFeeTotal.
_transfer indirectly triggers _rOwned balance updates through the token transfer pipeline.
transferFrom routes sender/recipient/amount into _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
transfer forwards _msgSender()/recipient/amount into _transfer.
_approve writes the owner/spender allowance into _allowances.
setBots flags each supplied address as true in the bots mapping.
delBot clears the bot flag for the supplied address.
tokenFromReflection reads _rOwned[account] to derive the token balance.
_transfer compares the buy amount against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer checks the inSwap lock before performing an automatic swap.
swapTokensForEth queries WETH and calls the Uniswap router.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the amount to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the amount to _feeAddrWallet2.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter exists only to drive the address checks and accounting inside _transfer.
The to parameter exists only for the bot, cooldown and pair checks performed by _transfer.
The amount parameter is consumed solely by the validation and delegation logic of _transfer.
tokenAmount is the sole input of the Uniswap swap performed by swapTokensForEth.
The fee amount parameter only feeds the ETH split performed by sendETHToFee.
bots_ is the loop input that writes into the bots mapping within setBots.
notbot is the single key cleared in the bots mapping by delBot.
This local is computed in _transfer and immediately handed to swapTokensForEth.
This local captures the contract ETH balance passed straight into sendETHToFee.
tTeam is produced by _getValues and consumed only by _takeTeam.
tAmount is the token amount threaded through _transferStandard and _getValues.
currentRate is the reflection rate local used to scale the team amount in _takeTeam.
